import torch
from torch import nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
class Model(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.activation = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
    def forward(self, h):
        h = h + 1
        view = h.view(-1)
        a = self.activation(input=h)  # preserve me
        return a, view
